architectureExclusions.note: Existing promenade, shade structures, hopper, playground, kiosk and planted margins.
Conservative access exclusion, including stairs and ramp; clips may be refined against model.plan components.

ownershipTransfers.reason: Small mapped kiosk inside the model-owned promenade strip; model agent includes its footprint.

furniturePolicy: Six sparse photo-read trees only; no mass placement of invented benches, parked vehicles or industrial equipment.
groundPolicy: Reuse the existing 5m bare-earth terrain and ground sampler. Public surfaces follow this terrain and do not flatten the coast. No bathymetry inferred.

sources.note: Roof-height estimates from first LiDAR coverage, not measured contemporary facade heights.

sources.title: IGN / PNOA Máxima Actualidad · retained orthophoto
sources.note: Retrieval date is not flight date. New roof envelope and six tree positions are read from this retained image; height and crown dimensions interpreted.

sources.title: Municipal photographs of the opened promenade
sources.note: Ground-level contrast of paving, port boundary and nearby warehouse facades.

integration.buildings: Only exclude these IDs from createCity once this module renders them; source footprints/holes stay unchanged.
integration.photoDerivedBuildings: Render as simple approximate envelopes; no replacement of cadastral geometry.
integration.surfaces: Conform to existing heightAt and clip against coast-pier model ownership. Do not add flat slabs or cover water.
integration.roads: Remove each sourceId from generic rendering only while substituting context roads plus the roadReplacements.segments remainders; retain source kind/surface/width metadata. Empty segments means whole-line ownership.
integration.curbs: Small interpreted edging following surface limits; trim at model/access ownership boundaries.

roadReplacements.method: Complement of original OSM centreline inside local context crop s[-500,270],c[-320,180]; endpoints interpolated on original segments.
